name: circle-social-platform
description: Circle: a full-stack social network (React, Redux Toolkit, Tailwind, Node, Express, MongoDB, Socket.IO).

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.build:all: npm ci --prefix client && npm ci --prefix server --omit=dev && npm run build --prefix client
